validation.storage: pytest isolated temporary databases; HTTP blocked by test fixtures

resumeSemantics: Reuse only persisted nonempty individual stages bound to the exact owner and current report basis.
Only missing trade/risk stages call models; the overall report requires both successfully persisted input analyses.
total/completed/failed/skipped and progress count newly scheduled work only; existing stages are not synthetic successes or skips.
Unsaved in-memory answers, blank rows and stale report bases never qualify as cache hits.
Stop and model/storage failures preserve existing and paid answers; no synthesis from unsuccessful input storage.
Daily/monthly/per-run token limits are outside the report basis; increasing them preserves otherwise-current stages.
targetedCases: stop before missing stage or before synthesis
restart after stop reuses newly saved input
real report basis stable under10M token limits
limits: The91tests use mocks/temp databases and are not a claim that the running production report queue has finished.
The running queue and requests were started by Root; this verification performs no API/model/phase start.
Budget figures are a single consistent read-only snapshot; later calls may reserve or settle more tokens.
Unpersisted paid answers remain outside the reusable analysis cache; no claim of recovering failed storage from request audit is made.
